purpose: Teach: 現像/楽屋/田園/器官/武蔵野/生理学/緑地/合体

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが昔、フィルムの現像をされたんですって
lines.en: Sho, your dad used to develop film, didn't he?
lines.style: Gentle, almost wistful. Soft opening. Warm curiosity, like she's holding onto a small detail he might treasure. Slow, warm cadence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祭りで楽屋の様子を見たよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I saw backstage at the festival!
lines.style: Bright, eager rush on the opening. Quick pace, almost breathless with the excitement of sharing. Bouncy energy — a six-year-old who has something important to tell her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの田園の絵、素敵ね
lines.en: That's lovely, Sho. Your grandpa's country paintings are really beautiful.
lines.style: Warm affirmation, like she's genuinely delighted by his observation. Soft focus — not overstating, but genuine. A gentle nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、理科で器官の名前覚えたよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I learned all the organ names in science class!
lines.style: Earnest, careful pronunciation — he's proud of getting these new words right. Medium pace, thoughtful. Little pause before the main fact, like he's gathering courage to share it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは武蔵野の風景画を描くのが好きなのよ
lines.en: You know, I love painting Musashino landscapes. There's something about that light.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant at first, then warmer. Speaking more to herself than to him, but including him. Trailing off slightly at the end, like she's remembering something.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、生理学のお話を授業で聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-san, we learned about how the body works in class today!
lines.style: Earnest, deliberate. Careful with the new vocabulary. Steady pace — he's proud but also grounding himself in the facts. Open, sincere delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと緑地公園にお散歩に行きましょうね
lines.en: Why don't we take your dad to the park for a walk? The green one?
lines.style: Soft, inviting. Slow opening, like an idea forming as she speaks. Warm and unhurried. The suggestion of something gentle and shared, not rushed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、レゴで車と飛行機を合体させたよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I combined my LEGO car and plane together!
lines.style: Bright, satisfied conclusion. Quick pace on the main fact. Warm pride in his invention. Small genuine laugh underneath, like he's still pleased with himself.
